data.name: Nazeeha
data.gender_notes: Nazeeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gives counsel, advice, or comfort. The name Nazeeha carries the meaning “Counsel, advice” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazeeha usually hope their child will grow to embody counsel, advice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents seeking guidance from Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Nazeeha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Counsel, advice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazeeha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نزيهة
in_arabic.meaning: نزيهة تعني الناصعة والخالية من الشوائب
in_arabic.long_meaning: نزيهة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'نَزَهَ' الذي يعني الابتعاد عن كل ما يدنس أو يشين. وصفاتها في اللغة العربية هي الناصعة، الخالية من الشوائب، الطاهرة. تحمل هذه الأسماء معاني روحانية عميقة متجذرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز النزاهة إلى الطهارة الروحية والأخلاقية.

in_urdu.name: نزیہہ
in_urdu.meaning: نزیہہ یعنی پاکیزہ، صاف، بی داغ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نزیہہ ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا اسم مؤنث ہے جس کا مطلب ہے پاکیزہ، صاف، اور بی داغ۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی پاکیزگی اور أخلاقی طہارت کی علامت ہے۔ اس کا استعمال اس بات پر زور دیتا ہے کہ فرد کی زندگی میں صفائی اور طہارت کتنی اہم ہے، نہ صرف ظاہری شکل بلکہ باطنی طور پر بھی۔

in_hindi.name: नज़ीहा
in_hindi.meaning: नज़ीहा अर्थात् पवित्र, शुद्ध, और निर्मल
in_hindi.long_meaning: नज़ीहा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है पवित्र, शुद्ध, और निर्मल। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरा अर्थ रखता है, जो आत्मिक और नैतिक पवित्रता पर बल देता है। इस नाम का चयन बच्चे के लिए एक पवित्र और शुद्ध जीवन की कामना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: نزېهه
in_pashto.meaning: نزېهه د پاکۍ او سادگۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نزېهه د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چې د پاکۍ، سادگۍ، او بې داغۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو کلتور کې د روحاني او اخلاقي پاكۍ د يو مهم سمبول په توګه کارول کېږي. دا داسې ځانګړتي لري چې د پاک زړه او بې ګناهۍ مفاهيمو ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Nazeeha
in_english.meaning: Chaste, pure, and free from impurities
in_english.long_meaning: Nazeeha is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'nazaha,' which means to be pure or free from impurities. The name connotes purity, cleanliness, and moral integrity. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes spiritual and ethical cleanliness, reflecting a person's inner and outer purity. Historically, names like Nazeeha have been popular across Muslim cultures for their deep religious and cultural significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazeeha holds a significant place in various Arab and Muslim communities due to its profound implications for social interactions. It suggests a person who is generous with their wisdom and warm in giving counsel and guidance. The name is often associated with individuals who are trusted confidants or well-respected figures in their communities due to their keen insights and ability to offer wise and compelling counsel to others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nazeeha is deeply rooted in the Islamic concepts of wisdom, guidance, and compassion. Upheld in the Qur'an as essential parts of living a righteous and contented life, these concepts hold a special place in the religious and philosophical traditions of Islam. The name Nazeeha thus signifies the divine attributes of God that are manifested through those who genuinely strive to help and guide others on their spiritual journeys towards self-improvement and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nazeeha is an Arabic name meaning "counselor" or "adviser." In Islamic context, it signifies one who provides guidance and support, embodying wisdom, compassion, and piety. The name is often given to girls who are expected to become wise and compassionate leaders, helping others navigate life's challenges.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah, Vol. 15, p. 181: Nazeeha bint Ka'ab al-Ashja'iyyah, an Ansariyah woman who was the wife of Abu Dujana Ansari and the sister of Amr ibn Al-Ashja'i. She was one of the wives of the Prophet (pbuh) and was called 'the possessor of two lights'.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history - Prophet Muhammad's wives

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari, The History of al-Tabari, Vol. 2, p. 212: Nazeeha bint Ka'ab, an Ansariyah woman and the sister of Amr ibn Al-Ashja'i. She was one of the wives of the Prophet (pbuh) and accepted Islam along with her brother and husband.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history - Prophet Muhammad's wives and migration to Medina
